Game Overview

Zombie Village puts players into a adventure experience centered on survive the undead apocalypse in Zombie Village, where strategic planning and sharpshooting keep you alive. Scavenge for weapons and use them wisely to fend off relentless zombies. Grow stronger and reap greater rewards in an immersive, desolate world that challenges every skill you possess.
